---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect behavior with a minimal reproduction
title: ''
---

## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual result. Include the version/commit, operating system, Rust version and whether you used the embedded API, HTTP, MCP or console.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest synthetic input and commands that reproduce the problem. Include timestamp units, event ordering and durability mode when relevant.

## Evidence

Include a sanitized error or result. Do not include tokens, passwords, auth files, private datasets or personal paths. Use private vulnerability reporting for security findings once the repository owner has enabled it.
